title: baseline.reproduction_requested (v1)
description: ResearchOrchestrator instructs RunnerAgent to reproduce the baseline of the frozen BenchmarkSpec under the frozen VerifierSpec's protocol. RunnerAgent itself is out of scope for this task (M10) -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

moss_intervention_ref.description: Persisted MOSS revalidation decision, including diagnosis for the baseline executor.

recover_completed_result.description: Restart recovery only; an explicit MOSS revalidation request requires a fresh run instead.

benchmark_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen BenchmarkSpec object whose baseline is to be reproduced.

verifier_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen VerifierSpec object whose protocol governs the reproduction run.
